statements.quote: We will be putting up a CAPEX of almost closer to INR 1,000 odd crores.
statements.target: Capex for display segment set at ~INR 1,000 crores FY27.

statements.quote: over a period of next 2 years, we should be able to expand our margins by 80 to 100 bps.
statements.target: Margin improvement of 80‑100 basis points over next two years.

statements.quote: So we should be hitting a number of 4 million in this category.
statements.target: Mobile phone unit volume target of 4 million FY28.

statements.quote: We feel that export numbers this year, we are targeting somewhere between 3.5 to 4 million.
statements.target: Exports volume target of 3.5‑4 million units FY27.

statements.quote: So we should be closing somewhere between 33 to 34 million without Vivo.
statements.target: Total mobile volume target 33‑34 million units FY27 (excluding Vivo).

statements.quote: On the Vivo side, ... we should be doing almost 8 to 10 million.
statements.target: Vivo customer volume target 8‑10 million units FY27.

statements.quote: We are migrating from the present hybrid category wherein we had committed a CAPEX of INR 250 crores under IT PLI 2 to the global category wherein we are upping our CAPEX plans to INR 500 crores.
statements.target: Increase IT PLI 2 capex from INR 250 cr to INR 500 cr FY27.

statements.quote: So, I mean, if you also can break it up into what is exports in Quarter 2 and where do you see the outlook for maybe next year? ... we feel we should be somewhere around 33-34 million.
statements.target: Projected export revenue for FY27 expected 33‑34 cr (implied from volume).

statements.quote: We expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter- on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book
statements.target: 20-25% Qoq volume growth in next quarter

statements.quote: The JV with Vivo to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal
statements.target: Vivo JV revenue start Q3 current fiscal

statements.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida is almost completed
statements.target: 1 million sq ft Noida facility construction nearly complete

statements.quote: expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually
statements.target: Q Tech camera module capacity increase to 180-190 million units in 15-18 months

statements.quote: Production of complex microwave backhaul radios for large global brand has scaled up successfully, and we expect to also commence exports of these products during the current fiscal year
statements.target: Commence exports of microwave backhaul radios in current fiscal

statements.quote: new manufacturing facility addition to our current facility in Chennai for a 60-40 joint venture with Inventec Corporation expected to get operational from Q4 of this fiscal
statements.target: Chennai JV facility operational Q4 current fiscal

statements.quote: addition of our new manufacturing facility in Tirupati will expand our capacities from 0.6 million units per annum by another 0.3 million units per annum
statements.target: Tirupati facility adds 0.3M units capacity in Q3 current fiscal

statements.quote: We expect the JV to commence operations and start reflecting in our revenues from Q3 of the current fiscal
statements.target: JV operations start Q3 current fiscal

statements.quote: Q4 volumes are expected to be somewhere between 7 million to 7.5 million.
statements.target: Smartphone volumes of 7M–7.5M units; full-year FY26 volumes approximately 34M–34.5M (27M in 9M + Q4).

statements.quote: We feel we should be closing at almost $5,500 crores, $6,000 crores in the current fiscal.
statements.target: Export revenue of INR 5,500–6,000 crores for FY26; management expects this to be the run rate into FY27 with additional large-partner export discussions ongoing.

statements.quote: we should be even a conservative basis, somewhere around 60 million, 65 million units
statements.target: Camera module volumes: 40M units in FY26, scaling to 190–200M per annum (180–190M in the next couple of years). A conservative floor of 60–65M units cited even in a worst-case scenario with sustained high memory prices and weak mobile volumes.

statements.quote: We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.
statements.target: Mobile phone operating margin of 2.8%–3.2%. If PLI scheme is not extended, a 0.5% headwind is conceded, though management expects backward integration to offset and add incremental margins (largest benefit in FY28, after 6–8 month ramp).

statements.quote: in the overall fiscal, it should be somewhere between $1,100 crores, $1,200 crores
statements.target: Total capex of INR 1,100–1,200 crores for FY26 (INR 720 cr already spent in 9 months). Display-business capex specifically INR 1,100–1,200 cr; QTech camera-module capex INR 250–300 cr.

statements.quote: Construction of a 1 million square feet facility in Noida ... expected to be completed by Q1 of financial year '26-'27 and mass production to start by Q2 of '26-'27.
statements.target: Noida 1M sq-ft facility for anchor customers: completion by Q1 FY27, mass production by Q2 FY27. 74:26 JV (4,000 sq ft) for smartphone/device manufacturing: operations by Q2 FY27. HVJ display-module facility (24M smartphone + 2M notebook units/yr, largely captive): trial by Q2 FY27.

statements.quote: for next year, the numbers are going to be somewhere around $3,500 crores to $4,000 crores
statements.target: IT and hardware (desktops, servers, telecom peripherals) revenue of INR 3,500–4,000 crores in FY27. Telecom segment revenue close to INR 5,200 crores in FY26, with a new order for complex backhaul microwave radios from U.S. customers.

statements.quote: we were taking in 20 million volumes coming from Vivo for FY27, we still don't have approval
statements.target: Vivo JV (PN3): 20M units expected in FY27, but contingent on PN3 approval. Even if approval does not materialise, the JV converts to a 100% subsidiary and production proceeds. A couple of months to a quarter of delay in integration is possible.

analyst_pushback: When challenged on whether the 20M Vivo JV volume for FY27 is at risk given the pending PN3 approval, management acknowledged dependence on approval timing and a 1–2 month integration lag, but did not offer a downside scenario for the volume number.

verdict.credibility_line: Management often promises, but results are still pending.
